summary: Replace the typed first-run setup questions with one full-screen checklist: names, start at login, every supported agent with its facts and paths, one consent line, one action with a result per agent.

replay.detail: No claim replay, projection rebuild or store recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema transitions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: st setup and the first plain st show the checklist when run in a terminal without --yes; pipes, --yes and non-terminals keep the line-mode setup and its flags unchanged. The config gains an optional top-level codex_work_without_asking (true or false), written only when Codex is found and the person saw the box, which is ticked by default. Ticked or unset, Codex seats get the install access mode as before; false makes the daemon start Codex seats with Codex's own approval defaults (it asks) plus hook trust bypass, in auto and bypass alike. A build that does not know the key rejects a config that has it, so downgrading after setup stored one means deleting that line. Setup output is captured while the screen is up and printed afterwards.

downtime.detail: No daemon lifecycle changes or additional service restart requirement.

manual.detail: No manual step or persisted-state migration.

recovery.detail: Delete codex_work_without_asking from config.toml to return to the unset state; restart the daemon so Codex seats launch with the install access mode again.
